exposure: perceived control (over birth environment, over birth process)
incongruence between the planned and actual birth experience
cohort: The study included 330 Israeli first-time mothers.
finding: The primary finding was that perceived control mediated the negative association between a medicalized birth and satisfaction, while incongruence between planned and actual birth predicted lower satisfaction, mediated by perceived care and guilt.
mod_finding: A more medicalized birth was negatively associated with birth satisfaction, partially mediated by perceived control.
